items.title: T3MP3ST Security Framework With 35 Tools, Turns AI Coding Agents Into 0-Day Bug Hunters
items.description: A newly released open-source security framework called T3MP3ST is turning general-purpose AI coding agents like Claude Code, OpenAI’s Codex, and Hermes into autonomous red-teaming operators without requiring new API keys, cloud infrastructure, or additional billing. items.title: Flipper Zero Firmware Development Continues With New Community Contribution Rules
items.description: Flipper Devices has responded to intense community backlash over perceptions that it had abandoned active development of the Flipper Zero firmware. In a statement addressing the controversy, the company announced it will allocate dedicated resources to firmware maintenance while overhauling how it engages with contributors and feature requesters.
